skill_name: Write a paragraph summarizing the character of Ralph in the novel Lord of the Flies
workflow: Ralph is the protagonist of Lord of the Flies and the leader of the island society. He is a fair and conscientious boy who seeks to live in a society that he believes will be best for everyone. He is often frustrated by his own inability to convince his peers of the ideas and actions he feels are necessary for the proper operation of their society.
